title: Enter the clinic details
summary: Trade name, contact, tax ID and main currency. The logo shows on quotes, invoices and on the patient portal.

steps.title: Clinic name
steps.details: It shows in reminders, quotes, invoices and on the patient portal. You can change it whenever you want: new documents take the new name.
steps.description: It's the name your patients see in messages, quotes and invoices.

steps.title: Upload the logo
steps.details: If you don't upload a logo, documents come out with just the name. A PNG with a transparent background is recommended.
steps.description: Choose a square image (PNG or JPG). It's used on printed documents and on the portal.

steps.title: Contact email
steps.details: It's the contact email patients see. Notifications go out anyway even if you leave it empty.

steps.title: Phone
steps.details: It shows on the portal and in messages to the patient so they can get in touch with the clinic.

steps.title: Tax ID
steps.details: Needed to issue invoices. Without a tax ID you can still work, but receipts come out without tax identification.

steps.title: Main currency
steps.details: Defines the currency for prices, quotes and the cash register. Changing it later doesn't convert what's already entered; the secondary currency shows the conversion when charging.
steps.description: It's the currency prices, quotes and the cash register are issued in. If you also charge in another one, choose it as the secondary currency.

steps.title: Review and save
steps.details: Saves the clinic details. Until you save, nothing I filled in is recorded.
steps.description: When everything looks right, press Save. I never save for you.
